summary: The `bad()` loop increments `i` with `i = (i + 1) % 256`, so `i` always stays in the range [0, 255] and the `while(i >= 0)` condition is never false, producing an infinite loop (CWE-835). I preserved the feature of writing the sequence of values by dropping the wrapping modulo and bounding the loop with `i < 256`, so it still prints 0 through 255 once and then terminates normally.
